intro.title: CSS Modules
intro.body: In this lesson, you'll build a simple profile card component using CSS Modules to style it. You'll learn how CSS Modules work by creating scoped CSS classes that only apply to specific React components, preventing style conflicts. The main technologies involved are React with TypeScript, CSS Modules syntax, and the module system for importing styles. You'll practice creating separate CSS files for components and applying those styles in a type-safe way. By the end, you'll understand how to organize component styles locally while maintaining clean, maintainable code.
intro.usecase: CSS Modules are essential for building scalable, maintainable UI components in large React applications like e-commerce platforms, SaaS dashboards, and content management systems. You'll use them to style reusable components such as product cards, data tables, navigation menus, and modal dialogs without worrying about CSS class name collisions. This approach is particularly valuable when multiple developers work on the same codebase, ensuring component styles remain isolated and predictable. For example, a dashboard with multiple filter panels and data visualization widgets can use CSS Modules to keep each component's styles self-contained while maintaining consistent design tokens.
